_comment: Words the chat masks and usernames may not contain (server/src/web/chat.ts).
A word matches a whole chat word after leetspeak is undone (0->o, 1->i, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 7->t, @->a, $->s)
and repeated letters are collapsed (fuuuck -> fuck). 'stems' also match as the start of a word
(fucking, shitty). Usernames are checked for stems anywhere and words as a whole part (split on _ and -).
